neighbours.label: the slot for a mental association or first thought ('you would think to', 'the first thing on your mind', 'immediately think of', 'seem odd'); the pole promotes 'associate', 'pair', 'connect'
fire: When people hear the word summer, most of them immediately think of beaches.
A dentist is probably the last specialist you would think to call about headaches.
Air pollution is not usually the first thing on your mind when you go cycling.
Many shoppers associate the colour green with healthy and natural products.
It might seem odd for a historian to want to learn computer programming.
The slogan is so famous that people instantly think of the brand when they hear it.
For most children, the word winter brings to mind snowmen and hot chocolate.
Few tourists would think to visit the city's sewer museum on their first trip.
quiet: When people hear the forecast for summer, most of them immediately book beaches.
A dentist is probably the last specialist you would visit about headaches.
Air pollution is not usually a serious problem when you go cycling in the park.
Many shoppers buy green products because they are cheaper this season.
It is common for a historian to learn several languages during a career.
The slogan is so famous that it was printed on every bus in the city.
For most children, the winter holidays bring snowmen and hot chocolate.
Few tourists visit the city's sewer museum on their first trip there.
